tool.name: Edgewonk
tool.description: Edgewonk is a cloud trading journal for forex, stocks, futures, crypto and options. You import trades, tag them and review reports on time of day, mistakes and trade management.
features: Automated trade imports. The site says more than 200 brokers are supported
One plan with unlimited trades and journals
Reports for time of day, drawdown, MFE and MAE, and trade management
Browser access on phone, tablet and computer

plans.name: 12-month plan
plans.detail: Both amounts were printed for 12 months on the same pricing page. VAT is added for the EU and UK.

tool.pricing_note: The official pricing page showed both $169 and $197 for 12 months on 11 Oct 2026, so confirm which one applies at checkout. A 14-day money-back window is described on that page.
